selected_evidence.requirement: NFS export and persistent client mount
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the active/enabled export, NFSv4.2 fstab configuration, recovered automount, and live NFS mount.

selected_evidence.requirement: Shared dataops identity, directory mode, and bidirectional permission consistency
selected_evidence.summary: Confirms UID/GID 4500 on both nodes, directory mode 2770, and files created from either system as dataops:dataops mode 660.
Captures healthy baseline boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, restored NFS service/export/data, and successful client I/O after recovery.
Captures healthy client baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered automount/NFS access, retained data, and a successful post-restart write.
Pre-change and final evidence show Ubuntu 24.04 with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic on both nodes.
